listing.name: Naruto: The Broken Bond — DIMASIK1502 Broken Bond Recomp (DIMASIK1502)
listing.summary: The project reports menus, story and combat working. NVIDIA graphics need Direct3D 12 ROV support to avoid black 3D output; Japanese dialogue hangs without the patched player. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own complete extracted disc, including game/default.xex. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, media ID or version.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow setup.ps1 with pinned ReXGlue 0.10.0 and its XMA drained-EOS patch. The Windows Direct3D 12 source build uses CMake, Clang 18+, Ninja and the Visual Studio SDK. This guide does not identify a release package.

warnings: The project reports menus, story and combat working. NVIDIA graphics need Direct3D 12 ROV support to avoid black 3D output; Japanese dialogue hangs without the patched player.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
